verdicts.reason: A: the headline runs almost to the right edge with no margin, the subtitle and logo start at a different left edge from the headline, and the CTA floats on its own at mid-right. The flavour pills sit below the CTA in a separate band, which breaks the reading order and leaves the layout looking scattered. B: one clean left column (logo, two-line headline, subtitle, pills, CTA) with good hierarchy, and the peach circle balances the right side. Minor flaws: the right half feels a little empty, and the pill labels are small.
